nowhere: There is nowhere to move this to. You can only add recordings to one library, and this is it.

access.working: Working out who this changes access for...
access.same: The same people can see it. Both libraries are shared with exactly the same people.
access.gains_one: {{names}} will be able to see it.
access.gains_other: {{names}} will be able to see it.
access.loses_one: {{names}} will no longer be able to see it.
access.loses_other: {{names}} will no longer be able to see it.

category.lost_one: It loses its category, {{names}}. Categories belong to the library they were made in.
category.lost_other: They lose their categories ({{names}}). Categories belong to the library they were made in.
category.none_one: It has no category to lose.
category.none_other: None of them has a category to lose.
category.destinationHasNone: The destination has no categories, so it arrives uncategorised.

individual_one: Anyone this recording was shared with individually keeps access, because that grant points at the recording rather than at the library.
individual_other: Anyone these recordings were shared with individually keeps access, because those grants point at the recordings rather than at the library.
